description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 25.3.1 [Alpha]
Fixes and minor improvements.

## Features
- Shape parity between multi object, single object and parallax objects.
- You can now shift click in the preview window to select multiple game objects.

## Changes / Improvements
- Improved some game object initialization.
- Glitch effect now has f2 rounding.
- Overhaul of the file saving to be more robust.
- Minor UI improvements.

## Bug Fixes
- Fix link injection vulnerability.
- Fix for alpha on dragging objects in some edge cases

## Modders Be Aware
- DataManager.GameData.BeatmapObject -> BeatmapObject

# [Alpha] -> [Default]
This build is a release candidate build for default. Assuming no major / game breaking bugs are found within 2 days, this build will be promoted to default.
